newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ABARE sees 2.4 mln bale Australia cotton crop.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ABARE sees 2.4 mln bale Australia cotton crop.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE) has reduced its forecast of Australia's 1996/97 (July-June) record cotton harvest to 2.43 million bales or 552,000 tonnes.
The estimate, in ABARE's latest Australian Crop Report, compares with its last forecast of 2.52 million 500 lb bales, or 571,000 tonnes.
The latest forecast production would still set a new Australian record, surpassing the previous record of 2.2 million 500 lb bales set in 1991/92.
ABARE said the reduction had been due to heavy rainfall in mid-February in the Gwydir, Namoi and Macintyre growing regions.
Total cotton plantings were forecast to increase by 29 percent to a record 391,000 hectares for 1996/97, with 313,000 hectares irrigated, it said.

Crop production from the irrigated area was forecast to be 2.22 million bales at an average yield of 7.1 bales per hectare, ABARE said. Dryland production was forecast at 49,000 bales at an average yield of 2.7 bales per hectare.
